about_the_game:
The castle walls are your only sanctuary, and they will not hold forever. You are the last Crusader, the final bastion against a tide of goblins, ghouls, and grotesque abominations bent on extinguishing the last light of the kingdom—your princess.

Crusader is a relentless, wave-based FPS that blends arcade action with deep roguelike progression. The gameplay is simple, but the challenge is endless. Every kill earns you coin, and every coin is a choice. Do you risk it all on a powerful new weapon, or gamble on a mystery mushroom upgrade that could turn the tide of battle? With each wave, the enemy grows stronger, faster, and more numerous. But so do you.

Master satisfying movement, find the perfect vantage point on the castle ramparts, and unleash a hail of steel and fire upon the monstrous legion below. Collect rare gems to unlock permanent upgrades, ensuring every run makes you a more formidable protector. This is not just a battle for survival; it is a quest for glory.

The princess is counting on you. Do not fail her, brave knight.

Features:

  • Relentless Wave-Based Combat: Face an ever-escalating army of goblins, giant spiders, twin-headed ogres and colossal walking castles.

  • Arcade FPS Action: Fast, fluid, responsive gunplay and melee attacks. Easy to learn but hard to master.

  • Roguelike RPG Progression: Spend coins on powerful weapons and roll on randomized upgrades at the Mystery Mushroom. No two runs are the same.

  • Permanent Prestige System: Collect rare gems to unlock permanent stat boosts and abilities that carry over between runs, making you stronger with every attempt.

  • Satisfying Movement: Utilize catapult jump pads, springy grapple hooks, wall-running, sliding, and a powerful damage dash to navigate your castle fortress with god-like agility.

  • Defend the Princess: The objective is clear, the stakes are high. Protect the heart of the castle at all costs!

  • Personal Bard: Tired of the sounds of battle? Toss a coin to your loyal bard and choose from over 15 Hours of beautiful, atmospheric music to score your slaughter.

  • Full Fantasy Flavor: Hidden Easter Eggs and loving nods to your favorite fantasy worlds.

  • Powerful Proverbs: Catch your breath between waves as your Princess imparts wisdom. With over 800 unique voicelines, every moment of peace is a chance for wisdom, reflection and inspiration.

  • Endless Replayability: How many waves can you survive? How powerful can you become? The crusade never ends.

content_descriptors.notes: Crusader is an action-packed fantasy game where the primary objective is to defend a castle against hordes of monstrous creatures. This involves frequent depictions of stylized, non-realistic fantasy violence and classic weapons.

Minimum:

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB Video Memory
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Stand alone against the endless horde. In this medieval FPS roguelike, defend your princess against waves of whimsical monsters. Slay, earn coin and gems, upgrade your power with the mystery mushroom, and become a legendary Crusader. How long can you survive, brave knight?
